items.title: AWS CloudWatch Omni納入AI代理品質測試，可比較模型與提示詞表現
items.summary: AWS擴充Amazon CloudWatch可觀測性服務，推出CloudWatch Omni，將AI代理與應用程式監控整合到同一環境。除了記錄延遲、詞元（Token）用量與工具呼叫等執行情況，CloudWatch Omni還能評估代理回答品質，並比較不同提示詞、模型與代理設定的結果，協助開發團隊找出版本變更後的品質退化問題。

items.title: Docker Cloud Sandboxes上線，AI代理環境可在本機與雲端雙向搬移
items.summary: Docker推出Cloud Sandboxes雲端沙箱服務，將原本在開發者電腦執行的Docker Sandboxes隔離環境延伸到Docker管理的雲端運算資源。開發者可讓AI程式開發代理在雲端執行大型程式修改、測試等工作，並使用sbx move指令，在本機與雲端之間搬移沙箱環境。

items.title: Anthropic動用近千Claude代理搜尋DNA，21小時找出新型ART酵素系統
items.summary: Anthropic公開生命科學研究團隊首批成果，近950個Claude AI代理搜尋大量DNA資料，找出過去未被描述的酵素系統ART（array-associated reverse transcriptases）。ART包含反轉錄酶、相鄰蛋白質與規律排列的DNA重複序列，DNA重複序列具有類似基因編輯工具CRISPR的排列特徵。ART的生物功能尚未確認，Anthropic已展開實驗研究。

items.title: Google AI代理PageBreak找出自家Web應用程式逾500個XSS漏洞
items.summary: Google近日公布內部AI代理PageBreak的漏洞研究成果，這套AI代理由Google產品安全團隊開發，用於尋找Google第一方Web應用程式的安全漏洞。目前PageBreak已在這些Web應用程式找出超過500個跨站指令碼（XSS）漏洞，部分漏洞出現在敏感網域。PageBreak找出疑似漏洞後，會交由專門的驗證工具執行實際酬載，確認漏洞能否成功利用。Google表示，這項驗證機制讓PageBreak的誤判率接近零。

items.title: fix: Side chat cannot answer on claude-cli installs without an API ke…
items.summary: fix: Side chat cannot answer on claude-cli installs without an API key (#157474) Closes #141483 ## What Problem This Solves Control UI Side chat fails with `missing-provider-auth` on subscription-backed `claude-cli` installs without a direct provider API key. ## User Impact Side chat can answer through a tool-free, one-shot CLI process when direct provider authentication is missing. Working direct-provider installations retain read-only tools and image support. CLI image questions return the existing `image-input-unsupported` error. No configuration, public API, or schema changes. ## Why This Change Was Made The automatic utility model normally uses the embedded runner. Reuse the existing CLI side-question owner only when provider credential resolution reports `missing-provider-auth`; other credential failures are not hidden. Carry the selected logical provider/model into CLI admission so permitted restricted operators can use Side chat. This follows the [recorded maintainer decision](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/157474#issuecomment-5827253713). ## Evidence Real built Gateway and Control UI, isolated state, synthetic session, and non-default loopback ports; no real Claude login or paid API key was used. **The external Claude executable and OpenAI-compatible provider are scripted boundaries.** Gateway routing, process launch, session snapshot construction, RPC transport, tool execution, image delivery, and UI rendering are real. - Main `1976a166443`: asking Side chat with a CLI primary and no API key fails; Gateway reports `No API key found for provider "anthropic"` and the UI displays its error. - Candidate: the same question answers through the stub `claude`. Captured argv includes `--tools ""`, `--disallowedTools mcp__*`, `--strict-mcp-config`, `--no-session-persistence`, and `--max-turns 1`. Its stdin contains the selected-session text and `ROUTE_PROOF_141483` snapshot marker. No resumed session is used. - CLI image request: RPC rejects with `image-input-unsupported`, without crashing. - Direct API-key route, before and after: the scripted provider requests the real `read` tool, reads `proof.txt`, and the answer contains `SIDE_CHAT_READ_PROOF`. A separate image question reaches the provider with the image and answers successfully. The same three read-only tools remain available. - Focused ask + RPC suites: **30 passed**, 42s wall including worker preparation; CLI/auth upgrade regression about 131ms. Removing the logical requester model makes the restricted-operator regression fail; restoring it passes. - Runtime-only Gateway + Control UI builds completed. Full declaration build was stopped at its 20-minute timeout; not claimed as passing. Main and candidate both report the same existing 62-byte startup CSS budget overage; no UI assets changed here. ### CLI-only install before ![Main: Side chat error without a provider API key](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3d7da51f-fde0-46dc-b3a7-c9f90f1d6746) ### CLI-only install after ![Candidate: Side chat answers through the scripted CLI](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3305887b-064f-4ef6-93ba-d8f589259160) Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi
